# AllToolss — Unified Developer, Security, PDF, Finance & AI Multi-Tool Suite

> AllToolss (https://alltoolss.com) is a high-performance, privacy-first web platform featuring 40+ production-grade online developer tools, passive VAPT security scanners, ATS resume checkers, 25+ PDF document operations, financial calculators, and astronomical calendar systems. All computations run in-server and client-side with 100% memory isolation and zero external third-party data tracking.

## Core Capabilities & Tool Directory

### Developer Utilities
- [JSON Formatter & Validator](https://alltoolss.com/json-formatter): Fast JSON tree visualization, minify, syntax check, and error highlight.
- [Regex Tester & Debugger](https://alltoolss.com/regex-tester): Interactive regular expression testing with cheat sheet and match explanations.
- [JWT Decoder & Inspector](https://alltoolss.com/jwt-decoder): Parse JWT headers, payload claims, expiration timestamps, and signature verification.
- [AI SQL Query Generator](https://alltoolss.com/sql-generator): Natural language to optimized SQL queries for PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, and SQL Server.
- [Gitignore Generator](https://alltoolss.com/gitignore-generator): Production-ready .gitignore configurations for 50+ languages and frameworks.
- [Base64 Encoder & Decoder](https://alltoolss.com/base64-encoder-decoder): Encode and decode strings, images, and binary payloads.
- [UUID v4 Generator](https://alltoolss.com/uuid-generator): Bulk RFC-compliant UUID v4 generation with custom casing and hyphens.
- [Cron Expression Generator](https://alltoolss.com/cron-expression-generator): Visual cron schedule builder with human-readable explanations.

### Application Security & Network Diagnostics
- [Website VAPT Security Scanner](https://alltoolss.com/vapt-scanner): Non-invasive passive security header audit (HSTS, CSP, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy), TLS inspection, and OWASP API Top 10 checklist.
- [SSL/TLS Certificate Checker](https://alltoolss.com/ssl-certificate-checker): Real-time certificate validity, cipher suites, expiration countdown, and SAN validation.
- [DNS Lookup & Propagation](https://alltoolss.com/dns-lookup): Query A, AAAA, MX, TXT, CNAME, NS, SOA records with DNSSEC verification.
- [WHOIS & RDAP Lookup](https://alltoolss.com/whois-lookup): Domain registrar details, creation/expiration dates, and status codes.
- [SPF / DKIM / DMARC Email Security](https://alltoolss.com/email-security): Mail domain deliverability and email spoofing protection audit.
- [Nmap Port Audit](https://alltoolss.com/nmap-scanner): Non-intrusive standard port availability and service detection.
- [Password Generator & Entropy Checker](https://alltoolss.com/password-generator): Cryptographically secure random password generation with Shannon entropy score.

### PDF Studio & Document Tools (25+ Operations)
- [Merge & Split PDF](https://alltoolss.com/document-tools): Reorder, join, and extract pages in memory without third-party cloud uploads.
- [Compress PDF](https://alltoolss.com/document-tools): Reduce file size with lossy and lossless vector compression.
- [PDF to Word / Image / Text](https://alltoolss.com/document-tools): High-fidelity format conversions.
- [OCR Text Recognition](https://alltoolss.com/document-tools): Extract text from scanned documents and images.
- [Protect & Unlock PDF](https://alltoolss.com/document-tools): AES-128/256 encryption and permission password removal.

### Finance, Calculators & Temporal Computing
- [Age Milestone & Cosmic Calculator](https://alltoolss.com/age-calculator): Chronological age, 9 solar system planetary orbital ages, biological heartbeats/breaths, and generational cohorts.
- [GST Calculator](https://alltoolss.com/gst-calculator): Inclusive and exclusive Goods & Services Tax calculations with CGST/SGST breakdowns.
- [SIP & Lumpsum Wealth Calculator](https://alltoolss.com/sip-calculator): Compounding return projections with inflation adjustments and graphical growth paths.
- [Live Indian Stock Market Indices](https://alltoolss.com/stock-market): Real-time Sensex and Nifty 50 ticker feeds.

### Cultural & Astronomical Almanac
- [Bengali Calendar & Panjika (১৪৩১–১৪৩৩)](https://alltoolss.com/bengali-calendar): Astronomical Surya Siddhanta calculations, live 6-period Bengali clock, Tithi, Nakshatra, Yoga, Karana, Disha Shool, Amritayog, Rahukal, and complete festival almanac.

## API & Programmatic Access
- REST API Documentation: https://alltoolss.com/api-hub
- Python FastAPI Backend: https://alltools-c30i.onrender.com/docs
- Key Endpoints:
  - `POST /api/v1/vapt/scan`: JSON payload `{"url": "https://example.com"}`
  - `GET /api/v1/age/calculate?birthDate=YYYY-MM-DD`
  - `GET /api/v1/bengali/today`

## Privacy, Security & Architecture
- **Zero Cloud Storage**: User uploaded files and input strings are processed in memory and immediately discarded.
- **Client-Side & Edge Server Execution**: Computations occur directly in browser WASM/JS or ephemeral server processes.
- **Architect & Maintainer**: Santanu Batabyal (Principal Application Security Architect).
